description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different generation methods applied to large language models of varying sizes across three scenarios on the CodeRepetEval dataset. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Metrics," displays four distinct, discrete categories ordered from left to right: "EGP ↑", "TR-N ↓", "TR-S ↓", and "CCP ↑". The vertical value axis, labeled "Performance," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with major numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, where each metric on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of four differently colored bars positioned side-by-side. According to the legend at the top center, the colors represent specific model and method combinations: blue for "Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)", yellow-orange for "RPG (CodeLlama-7B)", green for "Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)", and dark orange for "RPG (CodeLlama-34B)". Across the categories, the approximate values vary significantly. In the "EGP ↑" cluster, the blue bar represents the shortest value in the entire chart at approximately 0.01, while the dark orange bar represents the tallest overall value at nearly 0.99; the yellow-orange and green bars reach about 0.89 and 0.59, respectively. For "TR-N ↓", the values are roughly 0.71 (blue), 0.46 (yellow-orange), 0.62 (green), and 0.40 (dark orange). In the "TR-S ↓" category, the lengths correspond to approximately 0.68 (blue), 0.43 (yellow-orange), 0.45 (green), and 0.31 (dark orange). Finally, for "CCP ↑", the bars denote values of about 0.40 (blue), 0.72 (yellow-orange), 0.70 (green), and 0.94 (dark orange). The metric categories are not sorted by ascending or descending values, nor are they organized alphabetically, but the bars consistently follow the order of the legend from left to right within each cluster. Aside from the directional arrows included in the horizontal axis labels indicating desired metric direction, there is no visual emphasis such as shading, outlining, or specific numerical annotations applied to individual bars.
